Chapter 1407 - 18: Breakthrough, Second Realm

Chapter 1407: Chapter 18: Breakthrough, Second Realm

The second source world.

Since Lin Yuan ended the magic disaster, this source world has prospered once again.

Without the threat of Demonic Qi and creatures, cultivators can focus their main efforts on cultivation, leading to a rapid explosion of power among the strong in the three carefree realms.

Those cultivators who could withstand the pressure of the magic disaster have solid foundations.

As long as they arrive in a suitable environment, there is a high probability of making rapid progress in cultivation.

Just like a person who has been carrying a heavy burden for a long time, one day finally freed from it.

The outcome is self-evident.

Living for a long time in an environment suffused with Demonic Qi, their perception of the laws and the great Dao is obscured and restrained.

If they can break through this restraint, they can soar to the skies.

"All living beings..."

Lin Yuan sat cross-legged, his gaze encompassing the entire source world, with the future timelines of each being unfolding rapidly.

The intertwining and collision of countless beings’ timelines constitute the future of this source world.

"For non-time life beings, they are too fragile compared to time beings..." Lin Yuan thought.

This fragility is not physical but a deeper, existential fragility.

It’s like characters in a picture book, who, no matter how they stir up storms within the book.

For those outside the book, they can see through at a glance, and maybe the first time it’s interesting.

But after watching it multiple times, it no longer causes any emotional fluctuation.

A life of a twelfth-order consummate being, brilliant and extraordinary, is quite dull in the eyes of a time being.

"Perhaps, in the eyes of a Perfect Time Being, time beings are just as thin and mundane?"

Lin Yuan pondered privately.

Though he doesn’t know if a Perfect Time Being really exists.

However, with the means of a Perfect Time Being, so-called time life beings and non-time life beings are not significantly different.

In some sense, the fate of time life beings is ordained by the Perfect Time Being.

"Only by becoming a Time Lord can one have a slight resistance against the Perfect Time Being?"

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

At least Time Lords already have the qualification to challenge towards the Perfect Time Being.

Whether they succeed is another matter.

"Power, power is the foundation of everything, as long as the strength is strong enough, what can a Perfect Time Being do?"

Lin Yuan was rather eager in his heart.

The higher the realm, the stronger the power, the more one longs for strength.

Because only with powerful enough strength can one attain ’great freedom’, with one’s destiny not dictated by others.

Ordinary mortals might just want to live their life in peace.

But time life beings? How could they tolerate their destinies being predetermined?

"Chaotic Origin Taiji Dao..."

Lin Yuan’s mind stirred slightly, and before him, the Power of Yin and Yang interwove.

Vaguely forming a grand Dao.

"Once I comprehend the Chaotic Origin Taiji Dao, my power will soar."

Lin Yuan stared at the soon to be formed Origin Dao.

It’s not just an extra path in the Chaotic Origin Dao, but also a way to step into the Second Realm through this Origin Dao.

This is much greater enhancement for Lin Yuan than comprehending the Chaotic Origin Destruction Dao or Chaotic World Dao alone.

Although comprehending the Chaotic Origin Taiji Dao can still not make Lin Yuan rival a Perfect Time Being, at least he is getting closer.

Compared to other time life beings whose power has not improved over endless ages, Lin Yuan’s power progresses continuously.

Hardly encountering any significant bottlenecks.

...

Buzzing ~ The black and white Yin Yang Dao continuously interweaves, nearing the formation of the Chaotic Origin Taiji Dao.

This naturally begins to influence every law and principle of the entire source world.

Comprehending existing Chaotic Origin Daos does not cause much commotion.

For example, the Chaotic Origin Destruction Dao, because infinite dimensions already exist.

But the Chaotic Origin Taiji Dao?

Before Lin Yuan comprehended it, this Origin Dao did not appear in endless dimensions, and its birth naturally would resonate with countless Origin Daos.

However, because Lin Yuan is within the source world, this resonance will be confined to the source world.

It will not affect the interstitial spaces of endless dimensions.

...

"This commotion, is it the Galaxy?"

The Master of Infinite and other Eternal Lords were the first to sense the changes in every law and principle of the source world.

Their gazes all turned simultaneously towards the source of the change, where Lin Yuan was located.

"Is it the Origin Dao, has the Galaxy comprehended his own Chaotic Origin Dao?"

The Master of Black Space was somewhat stunned. Comprehending one’s own Chaotic Origin Dao signifies that he is about to step into the thirteenth-order Second Realm.

But how long has Lin Yuan been a time life being? For other newly ascended time life beings, this amount of time isn’t even enough to stabilize their realm, and Lin Yuan is about to enter the Second Realm?

The Master of Black Space had initially seen Lin Yuan’s future timeline, and was prepared for the Galaxy to enter the Second Realm, or even become a Time Lord.

But this is too soon, faster than any future timelines he has foreseen entering the Second Realm.

"Impressive, impressive, truly a predestined time life being." The Master of Wu Shan sighed with amazement.

With the timeline of a destined time life being as a foundation, the Master of Wu Shan found it not too unbelievable for Lin Yuan to comprehend his own Origin Dao so quickly.

There is a sense of surprise, yet also inevitability.

The other Eternal Lords were carefully feeling the fluctuation of the Origin Dao.

For a time being in the First Realm, sensing the fluctuation of a brand new Origin Dao is also an opportunity.

"This fluctuation..."

The Master of Infinite was stunned, though he was also in the First Realm, and had not experienced the comprehension of his own Origin Dao, he still keenly perceived ——
